ingredients: 1 tbsp yellow mustard (GERMAN ONE FROM ADELAIDE!!!)
1 large glass dill pickles, finely chopped
4 hard boiled eggs, peeled and chopped
method: Cook potatoes with salt (15-20 mins or until easily pierced with a fork)
While the potatoes cook prepare the dressing: a) Chop onions + pickles + herbs, b) Combine these and sour cream, mayonnaise and mustard in a small bowl
Add potatoes to a LARGE bowl and scatter the dressing over the potatoes
